name: jupiter
description: Jupiter Windows desktop AI agent foundation

scripts.dev: pnpm run metadata && pnpm --filter @jupiter/contracts build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/core build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/database build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/ai-runtime build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/mission-runtime build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/skill-runtime build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/workflow-runtime build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/ui build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/desktop dev
scripts.build: pnpm run metadata:production && pnpm --filter @jupiter/contracts build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/core build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/database build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/ai-runtime build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/mission-runtime build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/skill-runtime build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/workflow-runtime build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/ui build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/desktop build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run metadata && pnpm -r --if-present run test:unit
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run metadata && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.package:validate: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/desktop package:dir && node scripts/validate-package.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm run secrets:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @jupiter/desktop test:integration && pnpm --filter @jupiter/desktop package:dir && node scripts/validate-package.mjs
